prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her right in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the long earrings fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky with a soft healthy sheen, mid 30s, long glossy dark-brown waves swept to one side, vivid hot-pink coloured contact lenses with a thick dark outer ring and round natural pupils, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, eyes opened extremely wide with the whites showing all around the irises, a fixed unblinking stare, brows raised, a wide stretched grin showing teeth, a manic, unhinged expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): the absolute extreme of 'Russian lips', a cartoon-doll mouth made real: lips so tall and so plump that together they are as tall as the whole length of her nose and nearly as tall as the rest of her lower face, the upper lip towering and flared like a plump heart-shaped bow with two razor-sharp peaks, the lower lip a huge, pillowy, perfectly domed glossy cushion, the pout projecting extremely far forward from her face, so plump that the lips seem to glow, every edge razor-crisp, the mouth in proportion to the width of her face, so the lips are by far the dominant feature of her face in this three-quarter view; mirror-glossy pink-nude with bright white highlights on both lips, perfectly symmetrical, still reading as a beautiful, believable human face, never duck-like, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: an extreme, razor-sharp V-line: the cheeks taper in a long, smooth, straight diagonal from the ears down to a small, narrow, pointed chin, a very slim lower face with a sharply defined sculpted jaw edge. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about forty in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one straight bar across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; three small bar or rings through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a huge dome-shaped bell earring as large as her palm, with rows of tiny gem and pearl drops hanging from its rim, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit seven pieces above the lobe: four classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, two studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and one in the conch and tragus; three small studs on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; four small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Every piece on her face is bright and light-coloured, so that it gleams clearly against her deep skin: small polished gold and mirror-silver studs, rings and bars, and tiny clear diamonds and pearls. A forehead pendant: a fine gold chain runs along the centre parting of her hair and ends in a teardrop gem pendant resting at the middle of her forehead. A nose-to-ear chain: a fine chain swags from the ring on her left nostril wing across the cheek, well below the eye and clear of the lips, up to a hook at the top of her left ear. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real polished bright yellow gold and mirror silver set with clear diamonds, white pearls and icy pale gems, every piece light and gleaming, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
